method: Only the unchanged audio-lab/run.mjs validator expressions were evaluated against stored data, then against data with scenarios removed. No compiler, browser, or runtime suite was launched.

baseline.name: direct and Superdough 5/10ms attacks produce all notes
all idle sequences produce all notes
worklet release becomes silent without a large sample discontinuity
worklet bounds voices and releases all
finished Superdough voices leave the registry
Superdough has a finite default voice budget
production engine and scheduled voices match rendered attacks during input changes and stress
500 overlapping sample voices exercise the budget and clean up
ongoing production sixteenth-note intervals stay within 1ms of the audio grid
